verses.text: Since God has shown us mercy and given us this ministry, we don't give up.
We've rejected secret, shameful ways. We don't act deceptively or twist God's word. Instead, we openly present the truth and commend ourselves to everyone's conscience before God.
If our Good News is hidden, it's hidden from those who are perishing.
The god of this age has blinded the minds of unbelievers, so they can't see the light of the Good News of Christ's glory—Christ, who is the image of God.
We don't preach ourselves. We preach Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus' sake.
God once said, ‘Light will shine out of darkness.’ He has made his light shine in our hearts, giving us the light of knowing God's glory in the face of Jesus Christ.
But we carry this treasure in fragile clay jars, so it's clear that this extraordinary power comes from God and not from us.
We're pressured from every side, but not crushed; confused, but not without hope;
hunted down, but never abandoned; knocked down, but not destroyed.
We always carry in our bodies the death of Jesus, so that Jesus' life may also be revealed in our bodies.
While we live, we're always being handed over to death for Jesus' sake, so that his life may be revealed in our mortal bodies too.
So death is at work in us, but life is at work in you.
We have the same spirit of faith as the one who wrote, ‘I believed, so I spoke.’ We believe too, and that's why we speak.
We know that the one who raised the Lord Jesus will also raise us with Jesus and bring us with you into his presence.
All of this is for your benefit, so that grace may reach more and more people and overflow in thanksgiving to God's glory.
So we don't give up. Even though our physical body is wearing out, our inner self is being renewed every day.
Our present troubles are small and temporary, but they're producing for us an eternal glory that far outweighs them all.
We focus not on what can be seen, but on what can't be seen. What can be seen lasts only a short time, but what can't be seen lasts forever.
